verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own SDK offers natural-language selectors in place of hand-written ones, its agents pull data from websites, and its fetch feature converts any URL into JSON. Together these support LLM-driven extraction without pre-written selectors. However, no evidence shows an LLM reading a page and deciding which structured fields to extract, or any schema-driven extraction. missing for 10: documented LLM-driven structured/schema extraction API, evidence of the model choosing fields itself, examples of extraction output quality, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an LLM read a page and decide what structured fields to pull out without pre-written selectors

citations.quote: The SDK for browser agents. Natural language selectors, self-healing actions, and caching at scale.
Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included.
